# tcpshield_country_firewall_rule (Resource)

An entry in a network's country firewall. The API has no update for entries, so every change replaces the entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# country_id is TCPShield's own numeric id — country_code / country_name show
# what it resolved to.
resource "tcpshield_country_firewall_rule" "andorra" {
  network_id = tcpshield_network.main.id
  country_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_id` (Number) TCPShield's numeric country id (see `country_code` / `country_name` on an existing entry).
- `network_id` (Number) Network the entry belongs to.

### Optional

- `whitelist` (Boolean) `true` allows the source, `false` (default) blocks it.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) ISO country code TCPShield resolved `country_id` to.
- `country_name` (String) Country name TCPShield resolved `country_id` to.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric entry id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_country_firewall_rule.andorra <network_id>/<entry_id>
```
